caption: The drawing depicts a single, intricately carved, dark brown wooden object on a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a small, decorative platform or stand elevated on four short legs. The platform is rectangular but with ornate, curving edges and a raised, leaf-shaped carving featured prominently on its upper surface, surrounded by additional carved leaves and textured patterns. At one end of the platform, there are two handle-like extensions, also elaborately carved, that curl at the ends. There is no other object or additional color in the composition; the entire focus is on the carved wood object.
title: Trivet
